scope: Primary-source research notes; hypotheses for future experiments, NOT measured improvements

sources.title: ToolkenGPT: Augmenting Frozen Language Models with Massive Tools via Tool Embeddings
sources.mechanism: Learn additional tool embeddings in the language-model output head while leaving the backbone frozen; tool selection triggers argument generation and execution.
sources.distinction: A learned tool-selection interface, not an exact solver embedded in hidden layers or evidence that an untrained knowledge vector is automatically understood.
sources.local_hypothesis: The qualified native final hidden state could support a small learned tool-selection head without full-backbone training. Compare against text tool descriptions using held-out query templates and identical tool/execution budgets.

sources.title: DocPrompting: Generating Code by Retrieving the Docs
sources.mechanism: Retrieve documentation using the natural-language intent and condition code generation on the retrieved text.
sources.distinction: A textual retrieval channel, not hidden-state fusion. Its reported Python/Bash results do not establish Julia/Mantle performance.
sources.local_hypothesis: A fixed installed API pack is an initial oracle-retrieval ceiling. Only if it helps should retrieval quality be separated from evidence-use quality with query selection/irrelevant-document controls.
sources.limitation: The four authored transfer tasks are prospective after development but are not an independent public benchmark; the generic copy example is part of the public source pack.

budget_control_precedent.title: s1: Simple test-time scaling
budget_control_precedent.mechanism: Control reasoning duration by terminating it with its closing delimiter or extending it when the model would otherwise stop.
budget_control_precedent.distinction: The published project also trained a32B model on curated reasoning data. Our inference-only4B controller neither reproduces that training nor inherits its reported performance.
budget_control_precedent.local_hypothesis: At a fixed2048 total output allowance, reserving answer space may improve executable Julia completion relative to exhausting the entire allowance on thinking. This is not knowledge injection.

representation_controls: Use the same published source corpus when comparing native-hidden kNN memory with the earlier logit-projection memory.
Separate zero-mixture identity, shuffled labels, text context, and native-hidden mixture conditions.
Choose mixture weights and distance temperatures before observing task correctness; report all registered conditions, including truncation.
Do not pool post-hoc compiler gains, prospective authored tasks, public HumanEval tests, or infrastructure parity into a single intelligence score.
